job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibility
Design, develop, and deploy scalable data pipelines using Python.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business problems and develop solutions.
Develop and maintain large-scale data systems using AI and ML algorithms.
Conduct thorough testing and debugging of data pipelines and models.
Stay updated with industry trends and advancements in AI and ML.
Apply AI and ML techniques to drive business growth and improvement.
Job Requirements
Strong proficiency in Python programming language.
Experience with AI and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Knowledge of database management systems such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
